verdict.rationale: incident.io documents a public API hosted at api.incident.io with API-key authentication. Its API reference covers endpoints, examples, auth, rate limits and error handling, and offers a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec; separate Status Page and Widget APIs are also documented. The probe found no OpenAPI spec at the guessed paths, but that does not contradict the documented download. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API, and a verified reachable OpenAPI spec URL.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The API is hosted at `https://api.incident.io/`, and you will need an API key from your incident.io dashboard to make requests.
It documents available API endpoints, provides examples of how to use them, and covers authentication, rate limits, and error handling.
Download the full OpenAPI 3.0 spec to generate

incident.io provides two APIs for status pages: the Status Page API for programmatically managing incidents and maintenance windows, and the Widget API for embedding status data into your own product.
